entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
I need to return this VeloBand.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault with the band or a preference issue?
It's a preference. And I already tried to return it once.
I see. Do you have your order number handy so I can pull up your account?
Thank you. One moment... Okay, I have your order. It looks like the VeloBand GPS Tracker was delivered 42 days ago, on December 15th.
Right. And I tried to return it on day 9, but your whole system was down. I just got a 'website error' message and couldn't print the label. I have a screenshot of it.
I appreciate you explaining that, and I'm sorry you ran into trouble with our website. Let me just double-check the return eligibility for you... please hold.
Okay, thank you for your patience. Actually, it looks like you don't even need a special exception for the system being down. Our policy allows for returns up to 10 days after delivery.
Oh. So I wasted my time trying to do it earlier. Fine. Whatever.

You're well within the window, so I've gone ahead and processed the return approval for you. I've just sent a pre-paid return label to the email address on file. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
Alright. Once we receive the item back at our warehouse, your refund will be processed within 3-5 business days. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good day.
